questions.content:
A box contains white ball, red balls and black balls. Another box contains white balls, red balls and black balls. A third box contains white balls, red balls and black balls.

If balls are drawn (without replacement) from a randomly selected box and one of the balls is white and the other ball is red, the probability that these balls are drawn from box is
